title: Resume a living report by exact Task identity
description:
As an operator, I want a retried optimization attempt to resume the one Report already linked to its Task, so that the Report URL and revision history remain stable even when a Procedure runner rewrites its Task metadata projection.

Observed behavior: the Procedure runner replaced Task metadata and removed optimization-run identity fields. Resume interpreted the same existing Task as a new attempt, deliberately skipped Report lookup, created a second Report for that Task, and restarted revision numbering even though the original Report retained the exact run key, attempt ID, frozen specification, and revision history.

Feature: Task-linked Report authority during resume

Scenario: Task metadata projection lost report identity
Given an active Procedure Task already has one linked living Report
And the Task metadata no longer contains optimization-run identity fields
And the Report preserves the exact run key, attempt ID, and frozen run specification
When the same attempt resumes
Then the service resolves the Report through the Task relationship
And restores the Task identity projection from that Report
And reuses the fixed ReportBlocks and latest revision
And creates no Report or ReportBlock

Scenario: Task has no linked Report
Given a new Procedure Task has no linked living Report
When the living report starts
Then exactly one Report and its fixed ReportBlocks are created

Scenario: Conflicting Report identity is observed
Given a Task relationship resolves a Report with a different run key or frozen specification
When resume validates the relationship
Then the service fails closed with explicit integrity evidence
And does not silently choose or create another Report

Out of scope: GraphQL schema or resource changes; deleting or rewriting historical Reports.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Production dogfood evidence confirmed two Reports linked to one existing Task. The original Report retained the correct optimization_run identity and revision 1, while the resumed process created another Report and restarted at revision 1 after Task metadata lost optimization_run_key. Recovery must consult the Task-linked Report before classifying an existing Procedure Task as a new attempt.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Red/green evidence: recovery with an existing Task-linked Report and deliberately removed Task optimization identity first created a second Report. Recovery now resolves Report identity directly through getTask.report, validates the Report run key/attempt/frozen specification, restores only the missing Task identity projection while preserving Procedure metadata, and reuses the Report and fixed blocks. The default lookup no longer scans an arbitrary account window. Complete run-report suite: 85 passed.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Closed the stale Task-metadata overwrite path in the procedure runner. Metadata merges now reload the authoritative Task when a real API client is present and fail closed if that reload is unavailable; simple local fakes retain their prior behavior. Validation: 22 experiment-runner tests and 129 combined dispatcher, worker, runner, and living-Report tests passed.
